featureDescription: A fictional AI-assisted sharing feature that turns recent photos and videos into a polished private recap for a user's Close Friends list.

persona.name: Maya
persona.goal: Share event memories quickly with trusted friends without overposting publicly
persona.researchBasis: Pew and DataReportal research show Instagram is widely used by younger adults, making a privacy-conscious young adult sharer a plausible primary persona.

references.label: Pew Research Center Social Media Fact Sheet

stages.name: Awareness
stages.action: Notices a new Create Recap prompt after posting weekend photos.
stages.thought: This could save me from picking and captioning everything manually.
stages.painPoint: The prompt appears before Maya understands what will be included.
stages.opportunity: Show a short preview and clear Close Friends privacy badge.

stages.name: Consideration
stages.action: Opens the recap preview and scans the audience label and edit controls.
stages.thought: Is this really private, and can I remove awkward clips?
stages.painPoint: Privacy uncertainty creates hesitation before she continues.
stages.opportunity: Add explicit audience confirmation before setup.

stages.name: Setup
stages.action: Reviews her Close Friends list and removes a few contacts.
stages.thought: I forgot some people were still on this list.
stages.painPoint: Audience management interrupts the sharing flow.
stages.opportunity: Offer quick audience presets and recent-list-change reminders.

stages.name: Content Selection
stages.action: Chooses photos and videos, then lets Instagram suggest order and music.
stages.thought: The suggestions are good, but there are too many little choices.
stages.painPoint: Editing overload makes the recap feel like work.
stages.opportunity: Provide a good-enough default path with optional advanced edits.

stages.name: Preview and Edit
stages.action: Watches the recap, trims one clip, changes the cover, and edits the caption.
stages.thought: This looks better than what I would make manually.
stages.painPoint: She wants assurance that edits are saved before sharing.
stages.opportunity: Use autosave status and a lightweight before-share checklist.

stages.name: Share
stages.action: Shares the recap to Close Friends and sends it to two people in DMs.
stages.thought: Nice. That was fast, and it still feels personal.
stages.painPoint: She is unsure whether DM recipients can forward the recap.
stages.opportunity: Clarify forwarding behavior and private-share controls.

stages.name: Post-Use
stages.action: Sees quick reactions from close friends and saves the recap.
stages.thought: This is exactly the sharing I want after a busy weekend.
stages.painPoint: The saved recap could be hard to find later.
stages.opportunity: Create a memory collection and suggest the format after similar events.
